claim_scope: independent fixed-N replication of a post-hoc Shelf-4 diagnostic; not formal task-selection evidence and not pooled with the prior cohort

decision_rule.decision_data: replication cohort only; prior cohort is not pooled or used for classification
decision_rule.query_effect: support query effect only if a replication query-only logical/identity change occurs or a Bonferroni-corrected lower paired bound exceeds the frozen practical margin for at least one continuous endpoint
decision_rule.no_material_query_effect: supported only if replication corrected upper paired bounds are below both frozen practical margins and no logical/identity change occurs
decision_rule.inconclusive: all other complete replication outcomes remain inconclusive; failed queries or control logical/identity changes have explicit non-causal classifications
decision_rule.census_v3_gate: no_material_query_effect_supported makes census v3 eligible for a separate committed review only; it never launches automatically

privacy: public evidence contains replication pair/order labels, types, ordinals, counts, digests, anonymous deltas, intervals, and booleans only; no objectId, coordinates, exact poses, target points, or registry content
